summary: Preserve complete spaced CSI-style Submittal identifiers from filenames by passing the full bounded candidate through the existing conservative normalizer.
decision_refs: Active user goal to continue improving accuracy and adaptability across RFI, Submittal and email content
Existing rule that workflow links use exact normalized identifiers without fuzzy inference
approval_evidence: The active user goal explicitly includes continued Submittal accuracy and content adaptability improvements.
known_limitations: Filename metadata remains a routing hint and does not establish approval, authority or a design requirement.
Identifiers without a digit and non-exact or semantic filename relationships remain unsupported.
Validation is synthetic and offline; no model or external provider request is used.
